status.main_product: Drone-as-a-Service (DaaS) for surveying, mapping, and industrial inspections
status.scope_reason: The company provides drone-based topographical surveying, LiDAR corridor mapping, and photogrammetric spatial data acquisition services under its own brand.
status.evidence: According to the official Lesoko website, the company is an active Drone-as-a-Service provider delivering topographic, LiDAR, and photogrammetry drone mapping surveys across India from its headquarters in Chennai.

claims.claim: The company reports integrating its unmanned aircraft with radiometric thermal sensors and 4K visual cameras to execute simultaneous thermal and visual imaging passes during solar asset and wind turbine inspections.
claims.source: Lesoko Website (Drone Solar Panel Inspection Page & LinkedIn Post)

claims.claim: The company reports utilizing photogrammetry and LiDAR-based workflows to process raw data into digital surface models (DSM), digital terrain models (DTM), contour maps, and 3D point clouds.
claims.source: Lesoko Website (Ground Mount Solar Survey & DaaS Blog Page)

claims.claim: The company reports offering an in-house live dashboard for clients to log into, manage, and track defect maps and analytics processed from drone data.
claims.source: Lesoko Website (Drone Solar Panel Inspection & Transmission Line Inspection Pages)

claims.claim: The company reports that its drone surveys achieve sub-centimetre positional accuracy, typically better than 1 cm horizontally, utilizing RTK-GPS technology for solar, mining, and infrastructure projects.
claims.source: Lesoko Website (DaaS Blog Page & Ground Mount Solar Survey Page)

claims.claim: The company reports that its proprietary data processing delivers a 99.3% survey precision for critical infrastructure mapping.
The company reports operating a fleet of survey-grade drones including the DJI Phantom 4 RTK, Matrice 300 RTK, and other LiDAR-capable platforms for its drone services.

Lesoko Technologies Private Limited was awarded a commercial contract in September 2026 valued at 1.2 Lakh INR for an aerial LiDAR survey for a proposed 11 KV substation at FACT UC Udyogamandal in Kerala.

The company reports a client and partner ecosystem within the energy and infrastructure sectors that includes Tata Power, ReNew Power, L&T Construction, TNEB, Enerparc, Mahindra Teqo, Sterling and Wilson Solar, and Equinox.
claims.note: L&T Construction and Equinox are not confirmed as clients/partners explicitly under those exact names in the energy and infrastructure section on the company website, although Tata Power, ReNew Power, TNEB, Enerparc, Mahindra Teqo, and Sterling and Wilson Solar are listed.

claims.claim: The company reports providing transmission line inspection and drone night surveillance operations across 17+ states with its own fleet and in-house DGCA-certified remote pilots.

The company reports providing drone-based surveying and intelligence services to a client list that includes Equinox, Enerparc, Kriyan Eco Power, SKS Cleantech, TNEB, Mahindra Teqo, ReNew Power, and Tata Power.
The company reports providing over 5 lakh safe flights, inspecting more than 34 GW of solar assets, and surveying over 2.3 lakh hectares across 16+ industry verticals.

status.main_product: Drone surveying and LiDAR geospatial mapping services
status.scope_reason: The company provides high-precision drone-based topographical surveys, aerial surveys, and LiDAR mapping services under its own name.
status.evidence: According to the company's official website and active operational posts up to September 2026, Globe View Technologies Pvt Ltd provides drone topographical surveys and LiDAR mapping services from its head office in Dehradun.

claims.claim: The company claims its modern surveying workflows improve topographic accuracy, stating that laser sensors mounted on UAVs capture millimeter-accurate 3D point clouds and create precise Digital Elevation Models (DEM).
claims.note: laser sensors mounted on UAVs capture millimeter-accurate 3D point clouds and create precise Digital Elevation Models (DEM)

claims.claim: The company reports the successful completion of a detailed topographical engineering grade survey using drones for the 123 km Rishikesh-Karnprayag new BG Rail Link project in Uttarakhand.
claims.source: Globe View Technologies Official Website Blog
